notes.claim: The SQA Higher National unit Engineering Mathematics 1 says it would be advantageous to have good algebraic skills and to transpose engineering formulae, which is what this course trains.
Resistance changing with temperature is written R = R₀(1 + αΔT), where R₀ is the original resistance and R the resistance after a temperature change ΔT.

sources.title: Module 6 Resistance | Science 111
sources.quote: R = R ₀ ( 1 + α Δ T ) is the temperature dependence of the resistance of an object, where R ₀ is the original resistance and R is the resistance after a temperature change Δ T .

sources.title: national unit specification: general information (SQA H7K033, Engineering Mathematics 1)
sources.quote: it would be advantageous if learners had good algebraic skills together with an ability to transpose engineering formulae and solve simple trigonometric equations.
